static bool ts_lex(TSLexer *lexer, TSStateId state) {
  START_LEXER();
  eof = lexer->eof(lexer);
  switch (state) {
    case 0:
      if (eof) ADVANCE(21);
      ADVANCE_MAP(
        '\n', 22,
        '\r', 23,
        '!', 10,
        '"', 4,
        '$', 18,
        '%', 53,
        '\'', 12,
        '(', 40,
        ')', 41,
        '*', 51,
        '+', 44,
        ',', 37,
        '-', 43,
        '.', 17,
        '/', 52,
        '0', 30,
        '<', 47,
        '=', 39,
        '>', 48,
        '[', 25,
        ']', 26,
        0xef, 13,
      );
      if (lookahead == '\t' ||
          lookahead == ' ') SKIP(0);
      if (('1' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(31);
      if (('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'Z') ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'z')) ADVANCE(24);
      END_STATE();
    case 1:
      ADVANCE_MAP(
        '\n', 22,
        '\r', 23,
        '!', 10,
        '%', 53,
        '(', 40,
        ')', 41,
        '*', 51,
        '+', 44,
        ',', 37,
        '-', 42,
        '/', 52,
        '<', 47,
        '=', 11,
        '>', 48,
        '[', 25,
        ']', 26,
      );
      if (lookahead == '\t' ||
          lookahead == ' ') SKIP(1);
      if (('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'Z') ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'z')) ADVANCE(24);
      END_STATE();
    case 2:
      ADVANCE_MAP(
        '\n', 22,
        '\r', 23,
        '!', 10,
        '%', 53,
        ')', 41,
        '*', 51,
        '+', 44,
        ',', 37,
        '-', 42,
        '/', 52,
        '<', 47,
        '=', 39,
        '>', 48,
        ']', 26,
      );
      if (lookahead == '\t' ||
          lookahead == ' ') SKIP(2);
      if (('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'Z') ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'z')) ADVANCE(24);
      END_STATE();
    case 3:
      if (lookahead == '\n') ADVANCE(22);
      if (lookahead == '\r') ADVANCE(23);
      if (lookahead == '/') ADVANCE(9);
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(38);
      if (lookahead == '[') ADVANCE(25);
      if (lookahead == '\t' ||
          lookahead == ' ') SKIP(3);
      END_STATE();
    case 4:
      if (lookahead == '"') ADVANCE(29);
      if (lookahead == '\\') ADVANCE(15);
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(4);
      END_STATE();
    case 5:
      if (lookahead == '\'') ADVANCE(35);
      END_STATE();
    case 6:
      if (lookahead == '\'') ADVANCE(35);
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != '\\' &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(20);
      END_STATE();
    case 7:
      if (lookahead == '\'') ADVANCE(36);
      END_STATE();
    case 8:
      if (lookahead == '.') ADVANCE(34);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(8);
      END_STATE();
    case 9:
      if (lookahead == '/') ADVANCE(28);
      END_STATE();
    case 10:
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(46);
      END_STATE();
    case 11:
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(45);
      END_STATE();
    case 12:
      if (lookahead == '\\') ADVANCE(16);
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != '\'' &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(6);
      END_STATE();
    case 13:
      if (lookahead == 0xbb) ADVANCE(14);
      END_STATE();
    case 14:
      if (lookahead == 0xbf) ADVANCE(27);
      END_STATE();
    case 15:
      ADVANCE_MAP(
        '"', 4,
        '\'', 4,
        '\\', 4,
        'b', 4,
        'f', 4,
        'n', 4,
        'r', 4,
        't', 4,
      );
      END_STATE();
    case 16:
      ADVANCE_MAP(
        '"', 5,
        '\'', 5,
        '\\', 5,
        'b', 5,
        'f', 5,
        'n', 5,
        'r', 5,
        't', 5,
      );
      END_STATE();
    case 17:
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(34);
      END_STATE();
    case 18:
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9') ||
          ('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'F') ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'f')) ADVANCE(33);
      END_STATE();
    case 19:
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != '\'' &&
          lookahead != '\\' &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(7);
      END_STATE();
    case 20:
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != '\'' &&
          lookahead != '\\' &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(19);
      END_STATE();
    case 21:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(ts_builtin_sym_end);
      END_STATE();
    case 22:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_NewLine);
      END_STATE();
    case 23:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_NewLine);
      if (lookahead == '\n') ADVANCE(22);
      END_STATE();
    case 24:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_Identifier);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9') ||
          ('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'Z') ||
          lookahead == '_' ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'z')) ADVANCE(24);
      END_STATE();
    case 25:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_LBRACK);
      END_STATE();
    case 26:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_RBRACK);
      END_STATE();
    case 27:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_BOM);
      END_STATE();
    case 28:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_Comment);
      if (lookahead != 0 &&
          lookahead != '\n' &&
          lookahead != 0xff) ADVANCE(28);
      END_STATE();
    case 29:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_String);
      END_STATE();
    case 30:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_DecimalInteger);
      if (lookahead == '.') ADVANCE(34);
      if (lookahead == 'X' ||
          lookahead == 'x') ADVANCE(18);
      if (lookahead == '8' ||
          lookahead == '9') ADVANCE(8);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '7')) ADVANCE(32);
      END_STATE();
    case 31:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_DecimalInteger);
      if (lookahead == '.') ADVANCE(34);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(31);
      END_STATE();
    case 32:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_OctalInteger);
      if (lookahead == '.') ADVANCE(34);
      if (lookahead == '8' ||
          lookahead == '9') ADVANCE(8);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '7')) ADVANCE(32);
      END_STATE();
    case 33:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_HexInteger);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9') ||
          ('A' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'F') ||
          ('a' <= lookahead && lookahead <= 'f')) ADVANCE(33);
      END_STATE();
    case 34:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_Real);
      if (('0' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(34);
      END_STATE();
    case 35:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_SignedChar);
      END_STATE();
    case 36:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(sym_FourCC);
      END_STATE();
    case 37:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_COMMA);
      END_STATE();
    case 38:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_EQ);
      END_STATE();
    case 39:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_EQ);
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(45);
      END_STATE();
    case 40:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_LPAREN);
      END_STATE();
    case 41:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_RPAREN);
      END_STATE();
    case 42:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_DASH);
      END_STATE();
    case 43:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_DASH);
      if (lookahead == '$') ADVANCE(18);
      if (lookahead == '.') ADVANCE(17);
      if (lookahead == '0') ADVANCE(30);
      if (('1' <= lookahead && lookahead <= '9')) ADVANCE(31);
      END_STATE();
    case 44:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_PLUS);
      END_STATE();
    case 45:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_EQ_EQ);
      END_STATE();
    case 46:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_BANG_EQ);
      END_STATE();
    case 47:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_LT);
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(49);
      END_STATE();
    case 48:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_GT);
      if (lookahead == '=') ADVANCE(50);
      END_STATE();
    case 49:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_LT_EQ);
      END_STATE();
    case 50:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_GT_EQ);
      END_STATE();
    case 51:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_STAR);
      END_STATE();
    case 52:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_SLASH);
      if (lookahead == '/') ADVANCE(28);
      END_STATE();
    case 53:
      ACCEPT_TOKEN(anon_sym_PERCENT);
      END_STATE();
    default:
      return false;

TS_PUBLIC const TSLanguage *tree_sitter_jass(void) {
  static const TSLanguage language = {
    .abi_version = LANGUAGE_VERSION,
    .symbol_count = SYMBOL_COUNT,
    .alias_count = ALIAS_COUNT,
    .token_count = TOKEN_COUNT,
    .external_token_count = EXTERNAL_TOKEN_COUNT,
    .state_count = STATE_COUNT,
    .large_state_count = LARGE_STATE_COUNT,
    .production_id_count = PRODUCTION_ID_COUNT,
    .supertype_count = SUPERTYPE_COUNT,
    .field_count = FIELD_COUNT,
    .max_alias_sequence_length = MAX_ALIAS_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
    .parse_table = &ts_parse_table[0][0],
    .small_parse_table = ts_small_parse_table,
    .small_parse_table_map = ts_small_parse_table_map,
    .parse_actions = ts_parse_actions,
    .symbol_names = ts_symbol_names,
    .field_names = ts_field_names,
    .field_map_slices = ts_field_map_slices,
    .field_map_entries = ts_field_map_entries,
    .symbol_metadata = ts_symbol_metadata,
    .public_symbol_map = ts_symbol_map,
    .alias_map = ts_non_terminal_alias_map,
    .alias_sequences = &ts_alias_sequences[0][0],
    .lex_modes = (const void*)ts_lex_modes,
    .lex_fn = ts_lex,
    .keyword_lex_fn = ts_lex_keywords,
    .keyword_capture_token = sym_Identifier,
    .primary_state_ids = ts_primary_state_ids,
    .name = "jass",
    .max_reserved_word_set_size = 0,
    .metadata = {
      .major_version = 0,
      .minor_version = 1,
      .patch_version = 0,
    },
  };
  return &language;
}

}
